[name]
Grand Rapids, MI · [email] · [phone] · [url]

HUMAN RESOURCES BUSINESS PARTNER
SHRM-CP · Healthcare HR · Employee Relations · Workforce Planning · Compensation

PROFILE
Five years in human resources at a regional hospital system, progressing from HR generalist to business partner for a 1,200-person nursing division. Known for practical employee-relations work, clean data, and turning turnover numbers into retention plans that managers will actually use.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Lakeshore Health System, Grand Rapids, MI
Regional nonprofit hospital system: 4 hospitals, about 9,000 employees.

HR Business Partner, Nursing Division (Mar 2024 – Present)
Supports the Chief Nursing Officer and 38 nurse managers across inpatient units; 1,200 employees.
• Led the nursing retention program for the division: exit-interview analysis, stay interviews with 140 nurses, and a revised preceptor model. Registered-nurse first-year turnover fell from 31% in FY2023 to 22% in FY2025; division-wide turnover from 19% to 14%.
• Ran the FY2025 nursing compensation review with the compensation team: market-priced 42 job codes and recommended adjustments covering about $3.1M of annual payroll; approved by the executive team and implemented in two phases.
• Handle employee-relations cases for the division (about 90 a year): investigations, performance plans, and accommodations; no case escalated to litigation in two years.
• Coach nurse managers on performance conversations and engagement action plans; the division's engagement survey participation rose from 61% to 84%.
• Partner with Talent Acquisition on the new-graduate nurse residency intake (about 150 hires a year); redesigned the offer process so the average offer-to-acceptance time dropped from 9 days to 4.
• Prepare the monthly workforce dashboard (headcount, vacancies, overtime, agency spend) for the CNO and the hospital presidents.
• Led the division's response to the 2025 state nurse-staffing reporting rule: built the data pull with the HRIS team and submitted the first two quarterly filings on time with no corrections.
• Facilitate the Crucial Conversations course for new nurse managers (6 cohorts, about 70 managers trained since 2024).

HR Generalist, Shared Services (Jul 2021 – Feb 2024)
• Generalist support for about 700 employees across environmental services, food services, and facilities.
• Managed leave of absence administration (FMLA, short-term disability) for the client groups; reduced leave-processing errors flagged by payroll from about 12 a month to 3 after rewriting the intake checklist.
• Led the HRIS migration data cleanup for the shared-services population (about 700 records, 98% clean on the first validation pass).
• Conducted new-hire orientation twice a month; co-wrote the current orientation materials.
• Investigated and documented about 40 employee-relations cases a year.

HR Coordinator, Talent Acquisition (Jun 2020 – Jun 2021)
• Scheduled interviews and processed background checks and onboarding paperwork for about 60 hires a month during the pandemic hiring surge.
• Built the offer-letter template library that is still in use.

EDUCATION
Grand Valley State University — B.B.A., Human Resource Management, 2020
GPA 3.4/4.0. Society for Human Resource Management student chapter, vice president of programming (2019–2020).

CERTIFICATIONS AND TRAINING
SHRM Certified Professional (SHRM-CP), 2022
Crucial Conversations facilitator certification, 2024
Workday HCM, UKG Pro, Excel (pivot tables, lookups), Power BI (dashboards)

VOLUNTEER
Board member, Grand Rapids chapter of a regional HR association (2024 – Present); programming committee.
Volunteer resume reviewer, community job-readiness nonprofit (2021 – Present; about 30 sessions a year).
